i.norm: StringUtil.padding is a pre-built cache of space strings where padding[n] contains exactly n spaces. This avoids allocating new strings for common indentation widths (0–20).
The cache covers widths 0 through 20 inclusive, so exactly 21 entries are expected.
padding[i] must consist of exactly i space characters so that StringUtil.padding(i) returns a string of the requested width directly from the cache without any allocation.
